test_title: PYST 11: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: The Election Laws Amendment Bill passed in the Parliament recently seeks to implement certain electoral reforms. One of them is the eligibility date. Till now, only one date – 1 January was considered for deciding eligibility with respect to age. What reform does the Bill seek in this regard?

options.text: Introducing two dates – 1 January and 1 June
Eliminating the idea of eligibility date – enrolment throughout the year
Introducing four dates – 1 January, 1 April, 1 July, 1 October
Introducing three dates – 1 January, 1 May, 1 September

solution:
The correct answer is __**Introducing four dates – 1 January, 1 April, 1 July, 1 October**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Election Laws Amendment Bill aims to introduce **four cut-off dates** for voter registration based on age eligibility.
 
• Previously, only **1 January** was considered as the cut-off date for determining age eligibility for voters.
 
• The Bill proposes to add three more dates: **1 April, 1 July, and 1 October** to the existing 1 January.
 
• This reform will allow individuals who turn 18 by these dates to register as voters, **enhancing voter inclusivity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electoral Roll**

 
 
• The electoral roll, also known as the voter list, is an official list of individuals who are eligible to vote in an election.
 
• It is maintained by the Election Commission of India and updated periodically to include eligible voters.
 
• Individuals must register to be included in the electoral roll and be eligible to vote.
 
 
 
• **Election Commission of India (ECI)**
 
 
• The ECI is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering election processes in India.
 
• It ensures free and fair elections to the Parliament, state legislatures, and the offices of the President and Vice President in India.
 
• The ECI was established on 25 January 1950 under the Constitution of India.
 
 
 
• **Voter Registration**
 
 
• Voter registration is the process by which eligible citizens enroll themselves with the Election Commission to be able to vote.
 
• It involves providing personal details and proof of eligibility such as age and residence.
 
• Upon successful registration, individuals are issued a Voter ID card.
